text:
Eli Tran: Quick check — SecureKey marketplace launch still Wed 03/30? Need SSO + BYOK KMS validation by EOD Monday.
Maria Gomez: Yup, PM confirmed Wed. Security checklist: SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning smoke, KMS BYOK handshake, secrets-sync test in staging.
Devon K.: One blocker from Vault SI: TLS cert mismatch on their HSM proxy during last run. @Sean Liao any update?
Sean Liao: On it — found proxy config missing SNI header. Patch pushed to staging, can someone re-run the heartbeat?
Maria Gomez: Kicking off smoke now. Tagging PartnerBot to run the entitlement + integration checks.
PartnerBot: Running partner-scan for securekey-org. Results so far: SSO metadata OK. SCIM provisioning: 12/15 endpoints succeeded. KMS handshake: 1/3 key wraps failed. Run ID: pb-481234.
Helen Park: KMS failure looks like key-version mismatch — partner sending v2 signed blobs, we expect v3. Dev team prepping a tolerant parser to accept v2 for rollout window.
Eli Tran: Risk decision needed: accept v2 temporarily with compensating control (post-launch key rotate) or delay launch. Thoughts?
Devon K.: If we accept v2, require mandatory key rotation post-launch + add Console alert for any fallback usage. That's our safest path without blocking marketing.
Press Ops: Heads up — partner marketing set embargo lift Thu 00:00 PT. If we delay launch we need to push the PR and notify press.
Sean Liao: Re-ran pb-481234 after patch — KMS handshake now 3/3, SCIM 15/15. Staging looks green. :thumbsup:
PartnerBot: Re-scan complete. All tests passing. Note: partner cert expires 2026-05-01; recommend renewal 2 weeks before prod cutover.
Maria Gomez: Great — I'll update the launch checklist and add temporary v2 acceptance note plus post-launch key rotation task assigned to @Sean Liao. @Press Ops can you freeze the PR until we have final thumbs-up tomorrow?
Press Ops: Freezing PR. Please ping when we have prod green + key rotation plan.
Eli Tran: Action items: 1) Sean -> schedule/execute key rotation 24h post-launch, 2) Helen -> merge tolerant parser behind a feature flag (off by default), 3) Maria -> update runbook + notify partner. Ping me when done.
Sean Liao: Added task and will run rotation playbook tonight in dry-run: `scripts/rotate-keys --partner securekey --dry-run`. Will follow up with results.
Devon K.: Also creating a Console alert rule: metric `kms.fallback_count` -> page if >3 in 1h.
PartnerBot: Reminder scheduled: full integration smoke in prod on Tue 06:00 PT.
Eli Tran: Thanks everyone — aiming for green tomorrow morning. If anything changes, DM me.
thread_summary: Coordination thread for SecureKey marketplace launch covering SSO/SCIM/KMS checks, a KMS key-version mismatch (v2 vs v3), quick patch and re-scan, decision to accept v2 temporarily with post-launch rotation, PR freeze by Press Ops, and action items assigned.
